newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: THREE FOREIGN, TWO LOCAL BANKS EYE STATE BANK.
newsitem.headline: THREE FOREIGN, TWO LOCAL BANKS EYE STATE BANK.

text.p: Lithuania's finance minister Algirdas Shemeta said on Tuesday that Nomura and Estonia's Hansapank had submitted written applications to participate in the privatisation of the State Commercial Bank.
"Nomura and Hansapank have confirmed their interest in written form to take part in the privatisation of the State Commercial Bank," Shemeta told Reuters.
He added that one other Estonian bank had also submitted an application but did not name the bank.
"The winner of the bid will be announced before the start of summer," he said.

He also said that no local banks had given written applications but said that both Vilniaus Bank and Hermis Bank had expressed their interest in the privatisation of the troubled State Commercial bank.
The bank had a staggering loss of over 170 million litas in 1996 and analysts say it has serious problems.
